notes.title: Curve Games Publisher sale 2024
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/curvepublishersale_2024
][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/30ee8ddf9c6508d9d0668ff16c01acde47fb3e4c.png[/img][/url]

Our 2024 publisher event is here!
 
Grab your virtual hard hat and step into the bustling assembly line: this is where the magic happens, where code and pixels turn ideas into games that captivate millions of players around the world.
 
Take advantage of the best deals we ever offered, check out our new bundles and discover what games we are carefully putting together for the rest of year!

[h1]FOR THE KING II
[/h1]
We’re excited to bring forth this update as our Q1 Quality of Life update. The main focus of this update was to level up the current set of characters skill sets and kits and make certain characters a bit more fun to play. We also have a whole host of global changes - Find skills can now activate on vehicles, we’ve made some changes to how Taunt works, and the dreaded misclick on the overworld costing you focus can now be refunded! 

We’ve also made broad changes to the in-game encyclopedia, reworked tooltips to provide more pertinent information, added a few new settings, squashed a bunch of bugs and smoothed out a few areas of the game. We are once again asking the Kraken to drop more loot. 

[h1]SPACE CREW
[/h1]
Ready for an out-of-this-world adventure? From March 1st to 13th, dive into Space Crew: Legendary Edition for [b]FREE[/b] and keep it forever!

As we gear up for our upcoming release, Badlands Crew, we invite you to join us on a journey across the cosmos.

Take your chance to explore the stars! The offer ends[b] March 13th![/b]
See you among the galaxies! 🚀


[h1]WOBBLY LIFE
[/h1]
We are delighted to announce that Wobbly Life is now available on [url=https://www.nvidia.com/en-gb/geforce-now/how-to-play/]GeForce Now[/url]!

[b]What GeForce Now is:[
[/b]
GeForce Now allows you to play your games seamlessly on all your devices; transforming your laptop, desktop, Mac, TV, phone into the most powerful method of gaming!

[b]What else is going on?
[/b]
We’re continuing to work hard on our next update which is [b]coming soon[/b]! 
The next update will contain translation of the game in new languages, new costumes from the latest community contest and many more surprises on... and underneath… Wobbly Island.
We can’t wait to share more about our next update and we hope you will love it as much as we do! 🐸

notes.title: Vote I Am Fish for ‘Best Game You Suck At’ in this year’s Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Why is I Am Fish so hard? It’s a question we get asked a lot. 
If you’ve played any other Bossa games, like [i]I Am Bread[/i] or [i]Surgeon Simulator[/i], you’ll know that I Am Fish is perhaps the easiest of the bunch, although that’s not to say it’s without its challenges. 
That’s just the way Bossa makes games! But, once you master the controls, few games feel as good.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40617903/f56174fc0e81ca65eee8e494f689841e4ed3638a.png[/img]

If you do indeed suck at it, our best advice would be to get familiar with the idea of controlling a physics-based fish whilst inside a vehicle. That’s one of the core design principles. 
The vehicles vary, of course: sometimes it’s a fish bowl, on occasion it’s a bucket... you even end up in a human at one point! Regardless of what you find yourself in, it’s the fish you are controlling, so the key is to think about momentum and how that can affect the fish’s movement. 

I Am Fish has been referred to as “[i]An Aquatic Dark Souls[/i]” and it’s hard to disagree! However, we hope you enjoyed the frustration of managing the fishes’ journey to the ocean!

Vote to nominate I Am Fish for ‘Best Game You Suck At’ in this year’s Steam Awards!

We are also happy to announce we are offering I Am Fish at [b]33% off throughout the Autumn sale[/b]: follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/Autumnsale2021]this link[/url] to find out more.

Thank you,
Bossa Studios

notes.title: Texas Chainsaw Mackerel
notes.content:
On the surface, I Am Fish doesn’t seem like the kind of game that lends itself to Halloween, what with its sunny seaside visuals and charming cast. But if you’ve completed the game, or even just played through the whole of the third Piranha level, chances are you’ll be sufficiently shaken enough to understand why Rock Paper Shotgun described it as a “physics-based platformer that’s secretly a horror game.” 

With its creepy credentials firmly established, I Am Fish is even more at home at the heart of the Steam Halloween sale thanks to not only a gruesome discount slicing 25% off the asking price from now until 1st November, but a spooky update delivering a Halloween themed wallpaper (look inside your Steam depot folder if you dare), and to cap it all off an All Hallows ready set of Stickers and Avatar items introduced into the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1472560]Steam Points Shop[/url].   

No tricks, just treats from everyone at Curve Games and Bossa Studios.

notes.title: Hear from the Devs
notes.content:
I Am Fish is out now and we’re delighted with the incredible critical acclaim it has enjoyed. 

[i]“One of the most unique, compelling titles I’ve had the luxury of playing recently,” - [b]PC Invasion[/b]. 

“Home to some genius moments that you won't want to miss,” - [b]Rock Paper Shotgun[/b]. 

“Kept me laughing and shaking my head in disbelief.” – [b]IGN[/b]. [/i]

However, if you haven’t played I Am Fish yet you’ll be forgiven for being a little nervous given Bossa’s reputation for developing difficult games. Or you may have taken it for a spin already and are wondering why Bossa Studios decided to make the game so challenging. Whichever school you fall into, this Developer Diary is for you.

Watch Luke Williams, lead designer and Oliver Thurston, QA and level designer from Bossa Studios take viewers through the origins of I Am Fish, detail the design decisions that went into making it, and provide hints and tips as to how to approach the game’s potentially tricky moments.

notes.title: I Am Fish splashes onto Steam on September 16
notes.content:
Everyone at Curve Digital and Bossa Studios are whaley excited to announce that I Am Fish will release on Steam on September 16, 2021. 

I Am Fish is a charming, physics-based adventure starring four intrepid fish friends, forcibly separated from their home in a pet shop fish tank. While the game's demo, currently available to download, and footage of the recent beta might lead you to believe the game is a safe, family-friendly affair, this is not what developer Bossa Studios is angling for…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40617903/3f11b7d3fba16f1a5f5b4ae720e1d0026ab44356.jpg[/img]

You may have already witnessed the plucky Goldfish get lanced by a used syringe in the game's sewer section, but this is the tip of the iceberg in terms of the type of risky and risqué scenarios the fishy pals will find themselves in later in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40617903/de0af564a4f37848ce30bb29558fba965b2fed16.jpg[/img]

Today’s launch date trailer delves deeper into the game’s dingy underbelly, showcasing never before seen clips of Barnardshire County's pothole riddled roads, the local hospital and a clear example of why a Piranha should never be left alone near blood packs. Our Flying Fish friend takes to the sky and baggage handling area of the nearby airport while fresh Pufferfish footage provides a sneak peek into Barnardshire's hottest nightspot. 

[previewyoutube=pq96bGjdnNU;full][/previewyoutube]

I Am Fish will be priced £15.99, €19.99, $19.99 USD at launch. Add I Am Fish to your Wishlist to stay updated on the latest news. Follow I Am Fish on Twitter https://twitter.com/IAmFishGame for the latest updates, fish puns, and more.

notes.title: I Am Fish First Public Demo Available Today
notes.content:
There’s one game looking to make a splash in June, and that game is I Am Fish, the aquatic adventuring epic from the fine folks at Bossa Studios and Curve Digital. Beginning today, Steam users can grab the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1472560/I_Am_Fish/]I Am Fish demo[/url] and get hands-on with the opening “Goldfish” level!

Join our small-scale hero in making a break for freedom to the sanctuary of the sea. Navigate the busy town in the heart of Barnardshire county, rolling across rooftops and dodging crosstown traffic. The ocean is so close, but if you’re familiar with games from Bossa Studios, you know it can’t be that easy, right? Good thing you’ll have the option to replay the demo to improve your performance and boost your star rating. Aim for a quick time and avoid dying to unlock the elusive five stars!

In addition to the demo, Curve Digital and Bossa Studios are proud to announce their partnership with [url=http://uk.whales.org/]Whale and Dolphin Conservation[/url]. WDC is a UK -registered charity (no. 1014705) and is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection of whales and dolphins. With a vision of a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free, WDC fights for the survival of these beautiful creatures by ending captivity, stopping whaling, preventing deaths in nets, and creating healthy seas. [b]A donation from the sale of each copy of I Am Fish sold on Steam will go directly to WDC.[/b]

[i]"We are so grateful for support we’ve received from our friends in the video games industry over the last 12 months, which has had a huge impact on us being able to keep up our vital work protecting whales and dolphins in some uniquely challenging times," said Abbie Cheesman, Partnerships Manager at Whale and Dolphin Conservation. “Bossa and Curve have thought outside the bowl and chosen to help support our work to protect these amazing creatures through sales of the game on Steam, and we couldn’t be more delighted to work with them.”[/i]

Curve Digital Vice President Gary Rowe adds, “Protecting fish is the number one priority in I Am Fish, so it only makes sense to offer a way for fans of the game to help protect these animals we know and love.”

Fish fanatics can Wishlist I Am Fish on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1472560/I_Am_Fish/]Steam here[/url] to stay up to date on the latest news about the game. Join the I Am Fish [url=https://discord.gg/CHWUbYvf4M]Discord[/url] to be the first to receive brand new updates and make sure you follow I Am Fish on [url=https://twitter.com/IAmFishGame]Twitter![/url]

notes.title: "Dive Deep Into Bossa Studios & Curve Digital’s Upcoming Aquatic Epic I Am Fish
notes.content:
Curve Digital is proud to partner with Bossa Studios, the developers behind Surgeon Simulator to publish I Am Fish, the o-fish-al sequel to the smash-hit games I Am Bread and Surgeon Simulator.

I Am Fish is a charming adventure starring four intrepid fish friends, forcibly separated from their home in a pet shop fish tank. Throughout the game, players will join them as they swim, fly, roll, and chomp their way to the open ocean from the far-flung corners of Barnardshire (the smallest county in England) in their bid for freedom and to reunite once again.

The game features four playable fish: a Goldfish, Pufferfish, Flying Fish and Piranha(!) each with their own unique personality, abilities, and aquatic adventuring styles. Check out the reveal trailer to see just how deeply these plucky explorers can think outside the bowl on their journey to fishy freedom.
